why: A specific rule: final pay after leaving, plus gratuity.

turns.user: I resigned from a private company in Hyderabad on 30 September 2026 after 6 years. They still haven't paid my last month's salary or any gratuity. How long do they have?
turns.reply:
Under the law, your company was required to pay your final wages within **two working days** of your resignation [[COW2019:s17]]. Since your last working day was 30 September 2026, that deadline has already passed. 

Furthermore, because you completed 6 years of continuous service, you are legally entitled to receive gratuity [[SSC2020:s53]]. 

To help me guide you on the next steps and draft a formal demand letter to your employer:
1. Do you have a relieving letter or written confirmation of your resignation?
2. Have they given you any written reason for delaying your full and final settlement?
